caption: Figure 2: Overview of GiGPO. The agent interacts with a group of environments initialized with identical states to generate a set of trajectories {τ i } N i=1 . States with the same color represent the same environment state. GiGPO performs two-dimensional group computations (episode-level A E and step-level A S ) to produce hierarchical relative advantages that guide fine-grained policy optimization.
